total.label: Total number of buildings
total.help: All buildings in the project area, including industrial buildings.

areaM2.label: Total project area
areaM2.help: Enter the area in m². The value in hectares is shown next to it.

shares.label: Share of buildings
shares.help: Enter the share of each building type and construction period in %. All shares must add up to 100 %.

potentials.label: Energy sources
potentials.help: Select the energy sources available or potentially available in the project area and rate their potential.

pv.label: Photovoltaic (PV) available
pv.help: PV lowers the electricity costs of the heat pumps by the PV cost reduction of Table 6.

manualDemand.label: Known heating and cooling demand
manualDemand.help: Optional. If you know the buildings' energy demand, enter it here instead of the default estimate.

heatingKwhPerYear.label: Total heating demand
heatingKwhPerYear.help: Optional. Replaces the estimated total heating demand.

coolingKwhPerYear.label: Total cooling demand
coolingKwhPerYear.help: Optional. Replaces the estimated total cooling demand.

networkLengthM.label: Network length
networkLengthM.help: Optional. Leave empty to estimate the length from the building density and the project area.

heating.label: Heating capacity per source (Table 4)
heating.help: Annual capacity per potential level in kWh/a, and the heat pump COP. Leave a cell empty to keep the default.

cooling.label: Cooling capacity per source (Table 5)
cooling.help: Annual capacity per potential level in kWh/a, and the COP. Leave a cell empty to keep the default.

economic.label: Economic parameters (Table 6)
economic.help: Leave a value empty to keep the default.

residential.label: Residential buildings
residential.description: Residential buildings of different construction periods.

category_a.label: Category A
category_a.description: Retail, museums, supermarkets, schools, offices and fitness studios.

category_b.label: Category B
category_b.description: Kindergartens, sports halls, hotels and theatres.

category_c.label: Category C
category_c.description: Hospitals, restaurants, swimming pools and canteens.

industry.label: Industry
industry.description: Industrial buildings and facilities. No default values exist, so any industry share leads to "Further analysis required".

installation_costs_ambient_air.label: Ambient air installation costs
installation_costs_ambient_air.help: Table 6 gives no value; the Quick Check uses 0.

densityCategory.label: Building density category
densityCategory.help: Calculated from the building density, not entered.

further_analysis.label: Further analysis required
further_analysis.description: Mixed conditions, uncertainties or missing information

feasible.label: Feasible
feasible.interpretation: Sufficient annual energy potential to cover the total demand with additional potential available.

conditionally_feasible.label: Conditionally feasible
conditionally_feasible.interpretation: A small share of supplementary supply is required.

limited_feasibility.label: Limited feasibility
limited_feasibility.interpretation: A significant share of supplementary supply is required.

not_feasible.label: Not feasible as the sole supply concept

high.label: High density
high.interpretation: Densely built areas can benefit from shorter network lengths, although low energy demand may still weaken economic performance.

medium.label: Medium density
medium.interpretation: The structure may be suitable for a network.

low.label: Low density
low.interpretation: Buildings are more distributed, potentially increasing network length. High energy demand or suitable local energy sources may still make a project promising.

high.label: High density
high.interpretation: A relatively short network serves a high heating demand, potentially improving economic performance.

low.label: Low density
low.interpretation: A relatively long network serves a low heating demand. Substantial cooling demand or low network costs may improve the outlook.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.interpretation: Heating and cooling demand are similar, potentially supporting thermal exchange.

partially_balanced.label: Partially balanced
partially_balanced.interpretation: One demand is higher than the other, but thermal exchange may still be possible.

unbalanced.label: Unbalanced
unbalanced.interpretation: One demand clearly dominates, potentially increasing the need for external energy sources or thermal storage.

favorable.label: Favorable
favorable.interpretation: The revenues cover the annual costs.

unclear.label: Unclear
unclear.interpretation: The revenues cover a large part, but not all, of the annual costs.

clearly_unfavorable.label: Clearly unfavorable
clearly_unfavorable.interpretation: The revenues fall far short of the annual costs.

notRelevant.label: Not relevant
notRelevant.interpretation: There is no demand of this kind in the project area.

notApplicable.label: Not applicable
notApplicable.interpretation: This indicator cannot be calculated for the inputs.

equal.label: Heating and cooling demand are equal

industry.label: The project area includes industry. There are no default values for industrial buildings, so the result is set to “Further analysis required”.

unknown_source.label: The potential of {sources} is unknown. It needs to be clarified before a reliable initial assessment can be made.

economics_clearly_unfavorable.label: The economic assessment is clearly unfavorable.

low_coverage_and_densities.label: The supply cannot cover the {demands} demand as the sole supply concept, and building density and heat density are both low.

coverage_sufficient.label: The selected sources cover the {demands} demand.

densities_not_low.label: Neither building density nor heat density is low.

no_relevant_demand.label: There is no heating or cooling demand to assess.

coverage_below_promising.label: The selected sources cover too little of the {demands} demand for a promising result.

economics_unclear.label: The economic results do not support a clear conclusion.

limiting.label: Revenues do not clearly cover the annual costs

supporting.label: Local sources cover the heating demand

limiting.label: Local sources cover too little of the heating demand

supporting.label: Local sources cover the cooling demand

limiting.label: Local sources cover too little of the cooling demand

customParameters.label: Custom parameters
customParameters.hint: Some default values are overridden on the Assumptions page. Results use your values.

stepper.label: Quick Check steps
stepper.missing: Something is missing in this step

intro.area: A first assessment of the technical and economic potential of a 5GDHC network for your project area. Enter a few key parameters to see whether a network appears promising and which factors decide the result.
intro.buildings: Split the buildings into types and construction periods. The tool uses these shares to estimate the number of buildings in each group and their heating and cooling demand.
intro.sources: Select the energy sources available or potentially available in the project area and rate the potential of each one.
intro.options: Optional details. Leave a field empty to keep the estimate of the methodology.

area.pending: Enter the number of buildings and the project area to see the building density.

state.empty: Nothing entered yet. The shares must add up to 100 %.
state.over: {value} too much. Reduce the shares to 100 %.

buildings.industry: Industry has no default values. Any industry share leads to “Further analysis required”.

sources.none: Select at least one source to get a result.
sources.pending: Choose a potential to see the default capacity.
sources.unknown: Unknown potential adds no supply and leads to “Further analysis required” until it is clarified.

rail.title: Live result

incomplete.title: No result yet
incomplete.body: Complete these steps to see the result:

rail.screening: Initial indication, not a feasibility decision.

screening.title: Screening, not a full feasibility study
screening.body: This is an initial indication based on simplified default values. Actual values depend on project-specific conditions and should be refined through further analysis.

coverage.title: Supply coverage
coverage.lead: Heating and cooling are assessed separately, so supply gaps stay visible.

network.title: Network length
network.estimatedHint: Estimated from the building density and the project area. Enter a known length in Options.

unknown.title: Clarify the source potential
unknown.body: The potential of {sources} is unknown. It must be clarified before a reliable initial assessment can be made. Until then, the source adds no supply and the result stays “Further analysis required”.

incomplete.title: No result yet
incomplete.body: The Quick Check needs the number of buildings, the project area, shares that add up to 100 % and at least one energy source.
